user.title: Setup Pentair IntelliCenter
user.description: Choose how you would like to set up your IntelliCenter system.

discover.title: Select IntelliCenter Device
discover.description: Found {count} IntelliCenter device(s) on your network. Select the one you want to configure.

manual.title: Enter IntelliCenter Address
manual.description: Enter the IP address of your IntelliCenter system and select the connection type.

data_description.transport: TCP is the standard connection method (port 6681). WebSocket (port 6680) may be more reliable in some network configurations.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Connect to Pentair IntelliCenter
zeroconf_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name} ({host})?

firmware_warning.title: Known firmware issues detected

data_description.transport: TCP is the standard connection method (port 6681). WebSocket (port 6680) may be more reliable in some network configurations.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the IntelliCenter. Please verify the IP address and that the system is powered on.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please check the logs for more information.

abort.already_configured: This IntelliCenter device is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the discovered device.
abort.unknown: An unexpected error occurred during setup.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The device at this address is a different IntelliCenter than the one this entry was set up with. To add it, create a new entry instead.

init.title: IntelliCenter Options
init.description:
Configure connection settings for your IntelliCenter system.

Connected to: {host}

data_description.keepalive_interval: How often to send keepalive queries to maintain the connection. Range: 30-300 seconds.
data_description.reconnect_delay: Initial delay before attempting to reconnect after a connection loss. Uses exponential backoff. Range: 10-120 seconds.

firmware_2x.title: IntelliCenter 2.x firmware has serious known issues
firmware_2x.description: Your IntelliCenter panel is running firmware {firmware}. The 2.x line (2.006 / 2.017 / 2.026) has severe documented problems — broken schedules, pumps randomly commanded to 0 RPM, heater communication failures — and 2.006 and 2.026 were pulled by Pentair. The official upgrade path skips 2.x entirely: update to 3.004 and then 3.008 (update the wireless remote together with the panel), or revert to 1.064.

firmware_outdated_1x.title: IntelliCenter firmware is outdated
firmware_outdated_1x.description: Your IntelliCenter panel is running firmware {firmware}. Releases before 1.064 are long superseded and have documented protocol limitations. Pentair's official upgrade path is 1.047 → 1.064 → 3.004 → 3.008; update the wireless remote together with the panel.

capture.name: Capture MagicStream color
capture.description: Captures the current color on a MagicStream light.

thumper.name: Toggle MagicStream thumper
thumper.description: Toggles the thumper effect on a MagicStream light.

hold.name: Hold MagicStream color
hold.description: Holds and saves the current color on a MagicStream light.

recall.name: Recall MagicStream color
recall.description: Recalls the saved color on a MagicStream light.

color_sync.name: Synchronize light-group colors
color_sync.description: Synchronizes exactly two GloBrite lights in a complete IntelliCenter light group on firmware 1.064. The call waits for the physical action, a 60-second post-action observation, and a final controller read.

command_failed.message: The IntelliCenter command failed. Check the panel connection and try again.

cover_position_unsupported.message: This IntelliCenter firmware does not report cover position (no POSIT attribute); open/close is not supported. Update the panel firmware to control the cover.

invalid_heat_mode.message: The selected heat mode is not available for this body.

invalid_superchlorinate_duration.message: Superchlorinate duration must be a whole number from 1 to 96 hours.

magicstream_command_unsupported.message: This command is available only for MagicStream lights.

light_group_command_unsupported.message: Color Sync is available only on IntelliCenter firmware 1.064 for a complete light group with exactly two distinct GloBrite lights.

light_group_command_failed.message: Color Sync failed before dispatch or IntelliCenter explicitly rejected it. No action was confirmed.

light_group_command_uncertain.message: Color Sync dispatch started, but IntelliCenter returned no response. The action may have run. Inspect the lights and panel state before retrying.

light_group_command_incomplete.message: IntelliCenter acknowledged or visibly started Color Sync, but authoritative completion was not confirmed. Inspect the lights and panel state before retrying.

unknown_light_effect.message: The requested light effect is not supported by this IntelliCenter light.
